name: Furusaka Yui
source: Non-blood-related sister of [url=/c3295]Yuuya[/url]. Blames herself for the misfortune that plagues him, and overwhelmed by guilt she even offered her body to him. Has been missing since one year before. Has the power of "Shinsou" (soul performance).
